70602.commentary: (MNa) vodānapakkhan'ti… kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhammamhi visuddhipakkhaṃ addasan'ti attho.

70603.commentary: (DNa) vodāniyā'ti, samathavipassanā dhammā. te hi satte vodāpenti, tasmā vodāniyā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi, yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodāniyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti

70604.commentary: (DNa) vodāniyā'ti, samathavipassanā dhammā. te hi satte vodāpenti, tasmā vodāniyā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodānīyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.

70606.commentary: (DNa) vodāsaṃ āpajjatī'ti dvebhāgaṃ āpajjati, dve bhāge karoti. (DNt) vodāsan'ti byāsanaṃ, vibhajjanan'ti attho. taṃ pan'ettha vibhajjanaṃ dvidhā icchitan'ti āha dvebhāgaṃ āpajjatī'ti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī bhojanesu vodāsaṃ āpajjati, idaṃ me khamati, idaṃ me nakkhamatī'ti. so yañ'ca khv'assa nakkhamati, taṃ sāpekkho pajahati.

70607.meaning1: becomes fussy; is picky; becomes particular

70608.commentary: (MNa) paññāya vodiṭṭhā hontī'ti imasmiṃ ṭhāne sīlaṃ kathitaṃ, imasmiṃ samādhi, imasmiṃ vipassanā, imasmiṃ maggo, imasmiṃ phalan'ti evaṃ atthena atthe kāraṇena kāraṇe ciṇṇacaritattā maggapaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā.
kathañ'hi nāma ekadāsikāya divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ dassati, sīsaṃ vobhindissatī'ti.
katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te vobhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.
kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā aggaḷasūciṃ gahetvā sīse pahāraṃ adāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.
atha kho, pāpima, dūsī māro aññataraṃ kumārakaṃ anvāvisitvā sakkharaṃ gahetvā āyasmato vidhurassa sīse pahāramadāsi, sīsaṃ vobhindi.
kadā pan'ānanda, anuruddho saṅghamajjhe adhikaraṇesu voyuñjati! nanu, ānanda, yāni kānici adhikaraṇāni uppajjanti, sabbāni tāni tumhe c'eva vūpasametha sāriputtamoggallānā ca.

yena, bhante, gopālakena ajja buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho app'odakapāyasena navena ca sappinā sahatthā santappito sampavārito so kira, bhante, gopālako aññatarena purisena sīm'antarikāya jīvitā voropito'ti.

70617.meaning1: should be deprived (of); should be removed; should be cut off
70617.meaningLit: to cause to be taken down

examples.text: tañ'ca naṃ purisaṃ amittato'pi daheyya, paccatthikato'pi daheyya, api ca jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya, dīgharattaṃ vata, bho, ahaṃ iminā purisena telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena nikato vañcito paluddho, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti.

70618.meaning1: (of life) deprives (of); removes (from); cuts off (from); takes down (from)
70618.commentary: (VIN) jīvitā voropeyyā'ti jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopeti. (VINa) jīvitā voropeyyā'ti kalalakāle'pi tāpanamaddanehi vā bhesajjasampadānena vā tato vā uddham'pi tadanurūpena upakkamena jīvitā viyojeyyā'ti attho. yasmā pana jīvitā voropanaṃ nāma atthato jīvit'indriy'upacchedanam'eva hoti, tasmā etassa padabhājane jīvit'indriyaṃ upacchindati uparodheti santatiṃ vikopetī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya

khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.

70619.meaning2: wishing to deprive (of life); wanting to take down (from life)

examples.text: tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.

70620.meaning1: to deprive (of); to remove; to cut off; to take down (from)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.
tassa evam'assa, ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno, n'āyaṃ sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ anupakhajja jīvitā voropeyyan'ti

70621.meaning1: having deprived (of); having removed (from); having cut off (from); having taken down (from)

examples.text: pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathā'pi nāma puthusilā dvidhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti, evam'eva bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropetvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. tena vuccati, pārājiko hotī'ti.

addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparaj'akkhe mahāraj'akkhe, tikkh'indriye mud'indriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app'ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, app'ekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
atha kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesiṃ.

70643.meaning1: complete relinquishment; release; letting go; giving up
70643.commentary: (MNa) vossaggo duvidho pariccāgavossaggo ca pakkhandanavossaggo cā'ti. tattha pariccāgavossaggo'ti vipassanākkhaṇe ca tadaṅgavasena, maggakkhaṇe ca samucchedavasena kilesappahānaṃ. pakkhandanavossaggo'ti vipassanākkhaṇe tanninnabhāvena, maggakkhaṇe pana ārammaṇakaraṇena nibbānapakkhandanaṃ. tadubhayam'pi imasmiṃ lokiyalok'uttaramissake atthavaṇṇanānaye vaṭṭati. tathā hi ayaṃ satisambojjh'aṅgo yathāvuttena pakārena kilese pariccajati, nibbānañ'ca pakkhandati. vossaggapariṇāmin'ti iminā pana sakalena vacanena vossaggattaṃ pariṇamantaṃ pariṇatañ'ca paripaccantaṃ paripakkañ'cā'ti.

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ
saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassa ek'aggataṃ.

70654.commentary: (SNa) vossaṭṭhakāyā'ti ahituṇḍikaparibuddhaṃ agaṇetvā vissaṭṭhakāyā. (SNt) vissaṭṭhakāyā'ti ye cammena vā rudhirena vā aṭṭhinā vā atthikā, te sabbaṃ gaṇhantū'ti tattha nirapekkhacittatāya adhiṭṭhitasīlatāya pariccattasarīrā.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacce aṇḍajā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī'ti?

evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.

70658.meaning1: speaking; communicating; giving expression; using language
70658.commentary: (THa) voharantā'ti kathentā, saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya yaṃkiñci bhaṇantā. (THa) voharantā yath'ātthato'ti atth'ānurūpaṃ, aviparīt'atthaṃ dhammaṃ dhammo'ti, adhammaṃ adhammo'ti, vinayaṃ vinayo'ti avinayaṃ avinayo'ti evaṃ dīpentā.

examples.text: guṇavanto'pi saṅghamhi, voharantā yath'ātthato, dubbalā te bhavissanti, hirīmanā anatthikā.

70661.meaning1: (gram) should be used; should be employed

70662.meaning1: to speak; to express; to communicate

70663.meaning2: having used, having expressed, having called, having traded, having administrated

examples.text: kālaṃ vo'haṃ na jānāmi, channo kālo na dissati, tasmā abhutvā bhikkhāmi, mā maṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.

70667.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi… tathā tathā voharati aparāmasan'ti ayaṃ vacanavohāro nāma.

examples.text: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?
katamo ca, bhikkhave, saññānaṃ vipāko? vohāravepakkaṃ, bhikkhave, saññaṃ vadāmi. yathā yathā naṃ sañjānāti tathā tathā voharati, evaṃ saññī ahosin'ti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saññānaṃ vipāko.

70668.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi… saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro'ti ayaṃ paṇṇattivohāro nāma.

examples.text: ajito'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo'ti, icc'āyasmā ajito.

70669.meaning1: business activity; trading; commerce; business dealing
70669.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi… yo hi koci manussesu, vohāraṃ upajīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, vāṇijo so na brāhmaṇo'ti. ayaṃ byavahāravohāro nāma.

examples.text: yo hi koci manussesu, vohāraṃ upajīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, vāṇijo so na brāhmaṇo.
tathā hi pana me, bho gotama, sabbe kamm'antā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā'ti. yathā kathaṃ pana te, gahapati, sabbe kamm'antā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā'ti?

70670.meaning1: way of talking; mode of communication; verbal dealings
70670.commentary: (ANa) purimavohārā pacchimavohāran'ti purimakathāya pacchimakathaṃ, purimakathāya ca pacchimakathā, pacchimakathāya ca purimakathā na sametī'ti attho.

examples.text: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.

70672.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi… aṭṭha ariyavohārā aṭṭha anariyavoharā'ti ayaṃ cetanāvohāro nāma

70674.meaning1: mode of expression; way of communicating

70675.commentary: (SNa) vohāramattenā'ti upaladdhinissitakathaṃ hitvā vohārabhedaṃ akaronto, ahaṃ, mamā'ti vadeyya.

examples.text: yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ katāvī, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā, vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.

70676.meaning1: cutting off of all business activity; bringing one's affairs to end
70676.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi… yasmā vā pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya gihī'ti cetanā n'atthi, samaṇo'ti cetanā hoti. gihī'ti vacanaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo'ti vacanaṃ hoti. gihī'ti paṇṇatti n'atthi, samaṇo'ti paṇṇatti hoti. gihī'ti byavahāro n'atthi, samaṇo'ti vā pabbajito'ti vā byavahāro hoti. tasmā sabbe'p'ete labbhanti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti, api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassasī'ti?

70677.meaning1: resulting in verbal expression; developing into speech
70677.commentary: (ANa) vohāravepakkan'ti vohāravipākaṃ. kathāsaṅkhāto hi vohāro saññāya vipāko nāma.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, saññānaṃ vipāko? vohāravepakkaṃ, bhikkhave, saññaṃ vadāmi. yathā yathā naṃ sañjānāti tathā tathā voharati, evaṃ saññī ahosin'ti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saññānaṃ vipāko.

70678.meaning1: is called; goes by the name

examples.text: rajataṃ nāma kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.

70679.construction:
vi + ava + √har > hār + *a + ika
vohāra + ika
70679.commentary: (VINa) purāṇavohāriko mah'āmatto'ti bhikkhubhāvato purāṇe gihikāle vinicchayavohāre niyuttattā vohāriko'ti saṅkhaṃ gato mahāamacco.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇavohāriko mah'āmatto bhikkhūsu pabbajito bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.

70690.meaning1: experienced; learned; competent; trained; (comm) with clear understanding

examples.text: catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati. katamehi catūhi?

70696.meaning2: having abolished, having removed, having got rid of

70699.meaning2: having abolished, having removed, having got rid of
